lastCompletedStory.title: Gate meta_loop=auto dispatcher arming on worker_isolation=container

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-208) was the only story in this PRD; all non-operator stories now pass. The next cam-next invocation should find the PRD complete and route to /cam-review. buildMetaLoopFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts) is now exported (was previously module-private) so the regression suite in test/commands/sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts can call it directly against a tmpdir project.toml fixture; if a future story touches meta_loop wiring again, drive buildMetaLoopFn the same way rather than re-threading fakes through runSidecarLoop. src/supervisor/drain-preconditions.ts was deliberately left untouched (verified zero diff vs main) since the container-mode transient per-tick refuse must stay there, not move into the new boot-time gate.
